answer: On the reef ridge, every identity paints its own pigment band, and the toll doubles every ten identities: the first ten pay 100 pigment each, the next ten 200, the next 400, so ten pay 1,000 and a hundred pay 1,023,000, the hundredth alone 51,200. The ridge opens one gate per day, so the hundredth fake waits ninety-nine days and still pays the full 51,200 to pass.
